src/features/split/screens/home/HomeScre.rationale: Large interactive screen with tightly-coupled UI state and modal orchestration; split performed incrementally to reduce regression risk.

src/features/split/screens/flow/SplitIte.rationale: Recently split from ItemDetailScreens; still above threshold while preserving existing behavior and tests.

src/features/split/screens/shared/styles.rationale: Centralized design-token-driven style registry shared by many screens; planned decomposition by screen domain.

src/features/split/store.ts.rationale: Store currently concentrates persistence, reminder reconciliation, and state transitions; decomposition planned with stable API boundaries.

src/i18n/catalog.ts.rationale: Monolithic translation catalog kept in one file for now; migration to segmented language modules planned.
